title: Unique Umami Russian Beef Pilaf
description: A nutty and velvety Russian dish featuring ground annatto and a smoky heat, perfect for those looking for a sugar-free friendly meal option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the ground annatto, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the long grain rice and cook for 2 minutes, until the rice is coated in the spice mixture and slightly toasted.
Add the beef broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet, and simmer for 20 minutes, until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
